guardEvidence.howCaught: No new controller. An adopted run that ends without a result (crash, past its ceiling, record mismatch) re-drives through the existing handleErrorRetry and decideVerifyRetry, the registered local-verify retry controller: bounded error retries, then an error record with no re-run. The past-ceiling stop fires at most once per run (the settled latch in onExit). stopUnadopted is the existing boot-time kill of a live orphan, once per boot; the tick-time reap repeats it only while the group is still alive and never adopts.
